messages:
alex: Hey team — heads up, new oncall shadowing cohort starts next week. I want to coordinate primary/secondary for the weekend rota and make sure we don't have any coverage gaps. :wave:

priya: +1. who from the new cohort is ready to shadow live pages? we should pair them with someone who's comfortable doing page escalations.

matt: I can take primary for Sat morning (08:00-16:00) and shadow Sanjay on Sat night if that helps. I want to run through the paging runbook once beforehand.

lindsey: I'll be secondary on Sunday afternoon (12:00-20:00). happy to do a quick runbook walkthrough — maybe Wed 10:30?

alex: sounds good. plan: bootcamp shadows Wed/Thu -> paired live shadow Fri evening (low traffic) -> full rotations Sat/Sun. Who's comfortable being the trainer for the new cohort? we need someone to sign off on their 'able to acknowledge and escalate' checklist.

priya: I can own the checklist and sign-offs. i'll post the checklist doc in #eng-oncall resources. quick note: please ensure trainees have access to PD, Slack, and runbook links before shadow shift.

oncall-bot: [incident-bot] Reminder: runbook v2.1 published. Link: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/oncall-v2.1 — change log includes updated escalation path for dedicated capacity incidents.

matt: re: coverage gaps — there's a known gap Sun 20:00-00:00 if no one volunteers. i have a calendar conflict then. can someone swap?

sanjay: I can cover Sun 20:00-00:00 if needed, but prefer being secondary. I will swap with matt for Sat night shadow if that's helpful.

alex: okay matt -> sanjay swap noted. final weekend schedule: Sat 08-16 matt (primary), Sat 16-00 sanjay (primary), Sun 00-12 alex (primary), Sun 12-20 lindsey (primary), Sun 20-00 sanjay (primary). secondaries: priya for Sat, alex for Sun morning, priya for Sun afternoon.

lindsey: quick runbook pointer for trainers: the "ack+escalate" checklist is here: https://redwood.dev/docs/oncall-ack-escalate. Key sections to demo: how to parse the alert summary, where to check token-level cost spike dashboard, and the fallback model routing table.

priya: also share this snippet when onboarding — copy into trainees' notes:

```
Handoff template:
- Oncall: <name>
- Pager channel: #incidents
- Active incidents: <incident IDs>
- Known degradations: <short list>
- Hotfixes deployed: <sha>
- Next sync: <time>
```

alex: good. trainers — please do a 30m shadow prep session (demo walk-through) before pairing. Save a recording to the #eng-oncall/training recordings channel.

matt: one more ops tip — when you get a latency alert from the runtime pipeline, check these in order: 1) model routing logs (s3://redwood-ops/model-routing/), 2) pod CPU/GPU saturation + NVLINK errors, 3) KV cache hit rate. Runbook has commands: `kubectl -n runtime logs -lapp=serving -c runtime | grep ERROR` and `python3 tools/check_cache.py --model <model>`

sanjay: i'll shadow matt Fri evening and take Sat night primary. i'll also confirm all trainees have PD access by EOD Thursday.

oncall-bot: [pagerduty] Reminder: Trainee access checklist due Thu 18:00.

alex: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll update the shared rota and ping the cohort with their pairing. If any last-minute swaps, post here and mention @alex so i catch it. :thumbsup:
